hints.title: Always Pick Largest
hints.text: To maximize sum, always pick the maximum element available in the array.

hints.title: Arithmetic Sequence Addition
hints.text: Each pick increments the maximum element by 1, yielding m, m + 1, ..., m + k - 1.

hints.title: Closed Form Arithmetic Sum
hints.text: The total sum is k * m + k * (k - 1) // 2.

hints.title: Arithmetic Sequence Formula Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass to find maximum followed by arithmetic formula.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping k times is unnecessary when closed form arithmetic formula applies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Finds max in O(n) and calculates sum in O(1).
